t: Privileging Course for Circumcision (Dorsal Slit) Part 2 Series 5 (PCC 2-5)
r: A circumcision competency assessment course (Dorsal Slit), PCC 2-5. The date is booked; the venue will be announced once confirmed by the committee.
The comprehensive circumcision course CCC 9, scheduled for Sunday 13 December 2026 at Masjid Putrajaya. The date is still tentative.

MADOCS' first comprehensive course, featuring four circumcision methods with 5 lecturers and 12 hands-on trainers. 59 participants attended the course and 93 patients from the asnaf, poor and B40 groups benefited through the CSR programme sponsored by PPZ Wilayah Persekutuan.

MADOCS took part in the Malaysian International Circumcision Conference 2023 in Putrajaya. The President delivered a lecture titled "Roles of MADOCS in Malaysia" and MADOCS also held a session with the media.
The first Annual General Meeting was held at Hotel Tamu, Kampung Baru. At this meeting the first batch of 85 members was approved, marking the start of the organisation's formal membership.

During the first year, three committee meetings were recorded: on 18 February at Hotel Maluri Cheras, 31 March at Hotel Tamu Kampung Baru and 2 July at Yahala Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur. Day-to-day matters were handled through the committee's WhatsApp group.

The second comprehensive course featured five circumcision methods, 6 lecturers and 12 hands-on trainers. 57 participants joined the course and 76 patients received treatment through the CSR programme sponsored by PPZ Wilayah Persekutuan.
The President of MADOCS was invited to deliver the lecture "Introduction to MADOCS" at Perak Circumcision Update 2023, raising the society's profile at state level.

t: Ministry of Health Circumcision Guidelines Review Meeting
r: MADOCS represented the private sector at the review meeting of the Ministry of Health Circumcision Guidelines. The meeting agreed to establish a National Circumcision Committee and MADOCS was given two seats.

Teknoklem Train The Trainer (TTT) on Saturday 31 May 2025, the day before CCC6, at Hotel Maluri, Cheras. The session focused on the Teknoklem glue method: slide briefing, kit demonstration and hands-on practice by participants at their tables.

Comprehensive Circumcision Course 6 (CCC6) on Sunday 1 June 2025 at Hotel Maluri, Cheras. Lectures on anatomy and local anaesthesia, the Guillotine, Teknoklem and stapler methods, live procedure demonstrations, and hands-on training at three stations on real patients under facilitator supervision. The day before, a Teknoklem Train The Trainer (TTT) was held at the same hotel.

Privileging Course for Circumcision Part 2 (Series 1) in Batu Pahat, Johor. A total of 21 participants passed the course assessment. On the same day, a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Nano Medic Care was signed.

t: CCC7 Batu Pahat, PCC2-1 Batu Pahat and TTT Touchstone Stapler
r: The Privileging Course for Circumcision Part 2 (PCC2-1) and Comprehensive Circumcision Course 7 (CCC7) ran concurrently on 13 September 2025 at The Katerina Hotel, Batu Pahat, same hotel and floor, different halls, together with the Klinik Kurnia free circumcision programme and the MoU signing with Nano Medic Care. The Touchstone Circumcision Stapler Train The Trainer (TTT) session was held on 14 September 2025. Dr Darsono from ASDOKI (Indonesia) also attended.

t: Bengkel Teknoklem & Teknosealer di Depok, Indonesia
r: A delegation from MADOCS visited Depok, Indonesia on 23 November 2025 to study the origin and application of the Teknoklem and Teknosealer circumcision techniques.
The PCC2-2 course was held at Masjid Wilayah Persekutuan, Kuala Lumpur.
The PCC1-2 course was attended by 76 participants at Hotel Klagan Regency 1Borneo, Kota Kinabalu.

t: MADOCS CME, Aidilfitri Feast and 4th Annual Grand Meeting
r: MADOCS Programme 2026 (4 CPD points) combined a CME session, an Aidilfitri gathering attended by 80 people, and the 4th AGM with the election of committee members for the 2026-2028 term.
A webinar on post-circumcision wound care with Antaviro HOCl, held online from 9 to 11 pm.
The PCC2-3 course was held at Masjid Putra, Putrajaya (8 CPD points), with about 82 children registered. Executive Committee Meeting No. 1 was held the same evening.
The CCC8 course was held at Putra Mosque, Putrajaya, with hands-on sessions on 48 children.
The PCC2-4 course was held in Semporna, Sabah with lectures and practical training.
Executive Committee Meeting No. 2 discussed MADOCS programme and training plans.

t: Launch of the National Circumcision Guideline
r: The National Circumcision Guideline was launched by the Director-General of Health. MADOCS also set up a booth at the event.

t: CME talk by the President of MADOCS
r: Dr Abdol Rashid bin Masrom has been invited to present on the use of tissue adhesive in paediatric circumcision at a CME webinar with PERDIM, 24 November 2026, 2.00-3.00 pm.

t: Launch of the National Circumcision Guideline
r: The National Circumcision Guideline was launched by the Director-General of Health at the Auditorium of Hospital Shah Alam; MADOCS set up a booth at the event.
The MADOCS Executive Committee meeting was held at Qasar Balqis, Taman Melati to discuss programme and training plans.
A MADOCS delegation made a working visit to a circumcision clinic in Indonesia to share experience in managing circumcision services for children.

t: MADOCS in the Media: 150 Children Hosted in the MADOCS Circumcision Programme
r: The Kosmo! newspaper reported on the MADOCS mass circumcision programme in Semporna, which benefited 150 underprivileged children.
The PCC2-4 course in Semporna, Sabah ran alongside the mass circumcision programme that benefited 150 underprivileged children.

t: CCC8 Course at Masjid Putra, Putrajaya
r: The CCC8 course was held at Masjid Putra, Putrajaya on 31 May 2026, with a hands-on session involving 48 children.

t: MADOCS Programme 2026: CME, Aidilfitri Feast and 4th AGM
r: The MADOCS Programme 2026 (4 CPD points) at Howard Johnson by Wyndham, Kuala Lumpur combined a CME session, an Aidilfitri feast attended by 80 people, and the 4th AGM, where new committee members were elected.

t: Poster for the CME talk on Tissue Adhesives in Paediatric Circumcision
r: CME webinar poster, 24 November 2026, 2.00-3.00 pm (Teams). Co-organised by PERDIM and MADOCS, sponsored by Asumed Biotech.
